decisions.reason: Naval lighting has long, uncertain sales cycles and moderate keeping costs, so the firm retains this option while monitoring defence and marine demand.
General interior lighting is a core segment where broad coverage is needed, and this luminaire remains part of the portfolio with low uncertainty and low maintenance cost.
The pendant luminaire is still actively promoted as a unique new release, so its design-led prospects are unresolved and it is kept as a low-cost option.
Marine searchlight is a non-core niche with moderate uncertainty and the firm already dropped a similar HMI model, but it is still listed and serves transport customers, so it is kept for now.
